review.official:
Courier is a member of the
Karlan Trade Co. LTD
, and was born in
Kjerag
. He is part of the cooperation agreement between the Karlan Trade Co. and
Rhodes Island
, by which he helps carry out missions for the latter.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0%
Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

[Blood Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
This Operator has rarely come into contact with Originium.

Courier's keen sense of the terrain and environment is entirely from years of experience. In fact, when he was a child, he was not only unfamiliar with the roads, but he would even get lost. The way he tells it, he once got snowbound when he went out to play and almost didn't make it home alive. Fortunately, SilverAsh was hunting nearby and found him, thus returning him to safety. Because of this, no matter who might try to convince or threaten him to turn his back on SilverAsh, Courier will forever be the man's most faithful supporter.

As a race living in the cold regions of the plateau, the Itra have extraordinary resilience and endurance. Courier is no exception. Still, he likes to keep a low profile. He does everything with skill and with ease, and never lets anyone sees the limits of his abilities. Even SilverAsh is unaware of just what this Itra is capable of.

People enjoy having their letters delivered by Courier. Not only thanks to his attractive face and sunny disposition, but also because the letters he delivers have a faint fragrance about them. When the topic comes up, Courier will immediately change the subject. If pressed on it, he will hem and haw and his face will blush, a side of Courier very rarely seen.

Courier rarely loses his signature faint smile, though it should be noted that he has another side - a calm, tranquil, and peaceful side characteristic of one from the snowlands. Only his enemies and his most trusted friends get the chance to see that side of him. If he loses his smile while talking to you, that can only mean one thing - he regards you as a dear friend.

Most of the scars on Courier's body came from the people of Kjerag rather than beasts. After all, as an important man, SilverAsh has many enemies that want him dead. Courier always confronts these people in the dark. As for the fights with these rebels, only Courier's scars tell the tale - Courier himself says nary a word.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's not the duty of a guard to stand here and do nothing. Why don't we chat a bit?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: With perfect positioning and a suitable environment, my letters will arrive just fine. After all, it's my job, right? I need to do well to survive.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Are you hungry? If you want something to eat, just say the word. I can't compete with Matterhorn in the kitchen, but I can at least cook a decent meal.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The comms equipment here at Rhodes Island is way too good. At this rate, I'm going to lose my job...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Anything else you need? Just don't keep me on the line for too long.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Huh? There's a faint smell on the letters? No, you must be imagining things.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I owe my life to Master SilverAsh. If necessary, I would do anything for him.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You want me to transport... all these? That's a lot, Doctor! Come on, I'm not a miracle worker!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Seems I'm no match for you. I suppose it's time to retire my business smile for now... *Ahem*... I'd like to show you my true face, from now on.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, there's a new message for... Ah, never mind.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Esteemed Leader of Rhodes Island, your ally—Courier of the Snow Realm—is here at your service. If you get into any sort of trouble during your contract with Master SilverAsh, just snap your fingers and I'll be there.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa, that's an incredible job well done.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You'd save a lot of trouble if you sent me onto the battlefield.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: As a Messenger of the Snow Realm, I'm sure to appear whenever you need me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the scouting to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I won't blemish the name of the Snow Realm.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Too bad some people just can't live and let live.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They'll pay for what they've done.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mhmm.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Forwards!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Attack!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: How's that?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haaaghh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Speeding up!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'll bring news of our victory to Rhodes Island right away!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's grab a nice dinner after we clean up the battlefield. My treat!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Anyone injured? I've got medicine and bandages.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's get out of here first. Here, this way! Hurry!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll greet my roommates and neighbors first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: How can I help?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Alright, I'll whip up a meal for you later.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I've brought you some food from Kjerag to celebrate the New Year. They're still warm, so would you like to try...? Are they to your taste? D—Don't eat so many! The beastmeat isn't that easy to digest!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Call me whenever you need me.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! I have a present for you. You'd like to open it now? How about guessing what's inside first? Mm-hm... Correct, it's a scent sachet! I hope when you're carrying it around, you can feel as though I'm by your side.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It was Master SilverAsh's choice to partner with Rhodes Island, but I believed in his decision. And my days at Rhodes Island have proven not only how right he was, but also how trustworthy you are.
